rows.en: Nuoh…
Nuoh…
Defeat Beast Alien Doubleman!
Defeat all Shocker Combatants and Crusher Soldiers!
Defeat Beast Alien Doubleman and all Crusher Soldiers!
Defeat all of Makuu and the Shocker army! However, if an Executive Monster reaches the Makuu base before Gavan does, Machiko Shirakawa will die!
Defeat all Shocker Combatants, Beast Alien Doubleman and the Crusher Soldiers!
Dr. Shirakawa is defeated
Takeshi Hongo, Hayato Ichimonji or Retsu Ichijouji is defeated
Do you think they'll come?
Yeah… With us flashing around like this! They'll get curious and come out for sure.

…!?

Contact on the bio-radar. They're coming!
Huh!? This feeling… they're coming…
…!? It's those Kamen Riders! Hey, report to Doctor Death!
"All right, everyone… do it just like we planned!"
Oh n-nooo! Shocker has found out about our secret training!
Whaaat!? Damn, in that case… we'll beat them as our training partners!
Right!!
Isn't their acting a bit hammy? Those two?

I'm sorry, [HERO2]… I have no olfactory function.

If there is some source of a "hammy" odor, it would be in the form of fine particles in the air…
No, sorry. Forget it! This is no time for that…
Lucifard! Hit these guys all at once with your Gravity Napalm!
All right, Roaring Steel, maximum output!!
Oh, n-no! The Gravity Napalm's gone out of control???
It's Gebacondor!?
Damn Shocker… They've revived Gebacondor, haven't they?

We of Shocker will be taking Kamen Rider…

They will undergo brain modification surgery and become members of Shocker. The next time we meet, you're all dead! Remember that!

Did it work?

But will they really be all right? Hongo, Hayato…
Isn't the acting a little… too hammy? I wonder if it'll be okay…
[HERO2]! Let's beat up the bad guys too! Now, prepare yourselves!!
Oh, jeez… This one's an even worse case. It's hopeless.
Velvet! Hit these guys all at once with your Velvet Circle!
Leave it to me! Here I go… or something like that?
Ah!?
You idiot, what are you doing!? Attacking the Riders…
Damn Shocker… They've revived Gebacondor, haven't they?

We of Shocker will be taking Kamen Rider…

They will undergo brain modification surgery and become members of Shocker. The next time we meet, you're all dead! Remember that!

Did that really work?

Mr. Hongo, Hayato… will they really be all right?
Well done, Gebacondor! Your glorious name will be carved into Shocker's history for all eternity!

Heh heh heh…

Once we've disposed of Kamen Rider, who has thwarted us so thoroughly until now, the small fry left over are nothing worth worrying about.
Why not just kill them?

Heh heh heh, they have their uses…

Kamen Rider was originally… a cyborg made by Shocker.

And yet… they spout such impertinent drivel as justice and peace and love for humanity…

What Shocker makes must devote its power to Shocker!

Behold! The power of our Shocker scientists… Begin the enhancement modification surgery at once.
…!? What's that sound?
Where? Where is he?
There he is! Over there!
Turning innocent people into cyborgs for your own ends! Evil organization, Shocker army, I won't forgive you!
Another one of their friends! Get them all together!!
I won't let you! Here I come!
Oyassan told me what's going on! You're all being cold, leaving me out!
[HERO2]? By "cold," does that mean the air temperature is showing abnormal values?
[HERO2]? By "cold," does that mean the air temperature is showing abnormal values?
[HERO4]… Are you serious? That answer can wait until we beat the enemy!
[HERO4]… Are you serious? That answer can wait until we beat the enemy!
But… Jiro, you're always popping up out of nowhere. It's this day and age, get a cell phone or something.
But… Jiro, you're always popping up out of nowhere. It's this day and age, get a cell phone or something.
…!? What now?
Search, search!
Wherever there is evil, I will surely appear… Wherever evil is done, I will surely go. I won't forgive you, Shocker army!
What!? More of their friends! Report to Doctor Death!!
Let's go! Jiro!!
Warrior of justice! Kikaider 01!!
Ichiro, my brother!
Jiro!!
Doctor Death… The enhancement modification surgery on Kamen Rider has been completed successfully!

Ha ha ha, Kamen Rider!

Once the remaining brain modification surgery is done, you will become cyborgs who work exactly as I command.

With this, there should be no one left on Earth who dares defy me!

Please wait, Leader…

Before that, we'll use brainwave control to manipulate the subconscious of Takeshi Hongo and Hayato Ichimonji at will.
You mean… Kamen Rider 1 and 2 will…?

Takeshi Hongo and Hayato Ichimonji's comrades… We'll have Kamen Rider dispose of the remaining small fry!

Traitors killing their own comrades!

The brain modification surgery can be done at our leisure afterward…

Gebacondor! Use Kamen Rider to dispose of the small fry!
Fuyaeeh, fuyaeeh!
Are you both all right!?

…!? Something's wrong?

Don't tell me!?

…!?

What's wrong!? Takeshi Hongo, Hayato Ichimonji?

Do it already! Dispose of your own comrades! Go!
Hongo, come back to yourself! Switch your brainwaves!
Got it! Almost there…
…!? Don't tell me the brainwave control has worn off?
You badly miscalculated, didn't you?

The two of us are linked by telepathy, even thousands of kilometers apart!

Thanks to that, we switched each other's brainwaves and came back to ourselves!
Damn it, you'll pay for this!
For coming back without disposing of Kamen Rider and his allies, you'll be executed!

Gebacondor… I'll give you one more chance!

Defeat Kamen Rider once more and dispose of his allies! If you fail this time, your life is forfeit!

U02599/U02602: heroine hamming it up for the staged fight
